title: Tenacity terminal on_giveup hook
description: Public sync/async API task used to smoke-test persisted stage recovery.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The terminal hook executes exactly once with the final RetryCallState and correct ordering.
Retrying and AsyncRetrying correctly support synchronous and asynchronous hooks.
Copy, decorators, retry_with, error propagation, and disabled or non-retryable paths preserve the specified semantics.
Typing, documentation, and the upstream regression suite remain correct.
